coverage: Completed opening, forge and house/shop/museum shells and furnishing records; actual workshop steps/guards; halt-kit builders in their owning frames; greybox and town placements; opening props; real baked track kit (main lines and Home yard), Home station boxes; level-check walkway/pad boxes; default Home terrain mesh near pieces.
excluded: Moving actors, vehicles, animated/reveal poses, non-track GLB internals, museum animated exhibits, text/sign textures, particles and transparent effects.
Temporary scaffold poles, shadow-only proxies and alternative stage props are not exterior completed geometry.
Distant islands/Works and unconverted legacy decoration are not yet in the offline adapter; use the live scan there.
Service walkways, footbridges and tech pads use level-check timberDecks oriented-box adapters, not their detailed decoration.
